verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll does ship automations, including auto payroll and multi-step HR processes with custom approval chains, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, reviewing changes to automation definitions, or rolling them back. The ability to review and approve a payroll run before paychecks go out is an adjacent control on a single run's output, not version control over the automation itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
